name: Celtic Knotwork
desc: Endless interlaced Celtic knotwork of over-under woven cords threading a grid of crossings, perpetually re-threading as multi-hue bands drift and undulate — rendered as gilt illuminated-manuscript, neon glow-weave, carved stone relief, woven tartan, or black-on-cream ink.

scale.doc: cord thickness / zoom (higher = fewer, fatter cords)

warp.doc: undulation / turbulence of the weave (higher = wavier, more organic knot)

style.doc: render philosophy: gilt jewel bands on dark ground / glowing neon cords on black / carved grey stone relief (form from light) / woven multi-color tartan / flat black knot on cream ink

seed.doc: deterministic variation (phase, warp shape, hue arrangement)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
